note: Hard terminology rules for the AI reviewer runner (tools/review_runner.py, ut-docs#5420). terms.<weblate code>: a source term (matched case-insensitively as a word in the English) needs one of `target` in the translation and none of `forbid`; a miss is a failed pre-check (needs-fix, never approved). same_as_source.<code>: strings that are legitimately the same as the English in that language (otherwise the `untranslated` check fails them). Brand and technical terms (Universal Till, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, PIN, USB, QR, SKU, EAN, Code 128, Local Plus) are enforced by the runner itself. Add entries only when the term is settled for the language; frequency-derived terminology is a hint to the model, not a rule.
